name: AI Research Skills
description: Routes AI-research questions to the right specialist skill (training, fine-tuning, RLHF, evaluation, inference, RAG, agents, paper writing) and fetches its expert SKILL.md from the Orchestra Research library. Use when the user asks about ML/AI research, model training, or paper writing.
author: BMI AI Assistant

examples.prompt: How do I fine-tune Llama with QLoRA using Unsloth?
What skills are available for RLHF and post-training?
Help me write a NeurIPS paper

request.description: The user's AI-research question or task in plain words. Used for routing when category/skill_name are omitted.

category.description: One of: autoresearch, model-architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, mechanistic-interpretability, data-processing, post-training, safety-alignment, distributed-training, infrastructure, optimization, evaluation, inference-serving, mlops, agents, rag, prompt-engineering, observability, multimodal, emerging-techniques, ml-paper-writing, research-ideation, agent-native-research-artifact.

skill_name.description: Specific skill slug, e.g. grpo-rl-training, vllm, peft, faiss, langchain, dspy, whisper, flash-attention, megatron-core, lm-evaluation-harness.
